git-hero.title: Git Hero
git-hero.description: Fast and visual TUI for managing Git, written in Rust with Ratatui. A modern alternative to lazygit and gitui with interactive dashboard, 10 themes, i18n support, and CLI mode.
git-hero.longDescription: Git Hero is a high-performance Terminal User Interface (TUI) for managing Git repositories. It offers a visual dashboard with branch, remote, ahead/behind, file panel with change indicators, side-by-side diff, expandable commit history, and support for mouse and vim-like shortcuts. Includes 10 customizable themes, i18n (EN/ES), non-interactive CLI mode, and debug mode, all distributed via cargo, Homebrew, AUR, and snap.
git-hero.feature1: Visual dashboard with branch, remote, ahead/behind
git-hero.feature2: File panel with change indicators and side-by-side diff
git-hero.feature4: 10 customizable themes (Tokyo Night, Gruvbox Dark, Dracula, Nord...)
git-hero.feature5: Stage/unstage, commits, push/pull/fetch, stash, and branch management
git-hero.feature6: i18n support (English/Spanish), mouse, and vim-like shortcuts
git-hero.feature7: TUI interactive, non-interactive CLI, and debug modes

vitrina.title: Vitrina
vitrina.description: Full-stack e-commerce demo with catalog, filters and cart built on Next.js 16 and the Shopify Storefront API, ready to switch to a real store.
vitrina.longDescription: Vitrina is a portfolio demo store that replicates the complete e-commerce experience: product catalog with search and filters, detail page, shopping cart and embedded checkout, powered by the Shopify Storefront API through Hydrogen React. Built with Next.js 16 App Router, Tailwind CSS v4 and next-intl for ES/EN internationalization, with a sober editorial design (burgundy + ivory). No real payments: swapping in a store's credentials takes the project to production without rewriting code.

vitrina.feature5: Editorial design with burgundy and ivory palette
vitrina.feature6: Ready to switch to a real store with credentials

repo-xpert.title: Repo Xpert
repo-xpert.description: Git repository analyzer in your terminal, in pure read-only Rust: churn, hotspots, ownership and coupling computed directly from the .git objects.
repo-xpert.longDescription: Repo Xpert answers "what does this repository mean", not just "what changed". It reads history directly from .git objects with gix —no subprocess, no porcelain parsing— and computes four metrics: churn (added + deleted lines), hotspots (churn × LOC as an ASCII scatter), ownership/bus factor and coupling (files that co-change, with Jaccard scores). A 10,000-commit repo indexes in ~1.3s (parallel via rayon) and reopens in ~60ms from a versioned cache inside .git/repo-xpert/. Strictly read-only: no network, no credentials, no writes to your working tree. Forked from git-hero, reusing its TUI scaffolding and themes.
repo-xpert.feature1: Analytics engine over .git objects with gix, no git subprocess
repo-xpert.feature2: Four metrics: churn, hotspots (churn × LOC), ownership/bus factor and coupling (Jaccard)
repo-xpert.feature3: 4-tab TUI (Summary · Churn · Hotspots · Ownership) with ASCII scatter and readable tables
repo-xpert.feature4: Incremental versioned JSON cache in .git/repo-xpert/: ~1.3s first index, ~60ms reopen
repo-xpert.feature5: Headless `gadv scan` mode for scripts and CI, with per-file co-change neighbors
repo-xpert.feature6: Strictly read-only: no network, no credentials, no writes to the working tree
repo-xpert.feature7: Lockfiles, vendor/, dist/ and mega-commits filtered out of hotspots and coupling

afiche-studio.title: Afiche Studio
afiche-studio.description: Self-hosted promotional image generator (PNG/WEBP/JPG) from HTML/CSS: a single #canvas exported to six formats with a browser editor and a CLI.
afiche-studio.longDescription: Afiche Studio turns an HTML/CSS #canvas into high-resolution images for posts, stories, thumbnails, banners and Open Graph. Studio mode (localhost:4560): edit index.html and styles.css with autosave, live-reload preview over SSE, chips to see the same design in every variant, and a PNG/WEBP/JPG export panel at 1x–3x scale. The CLI renders per preset (--preset post|story|thumb|banner|og|wide), with --all, --json and scaffolding that scans an app's global CSS design tokens (--app). Everything runs on your machine: no account, no cloud, no telemetry. 27 tests with node:test, zero extra deps. Sister project of hyper-frames-videos: same philosophy, static image instead of video.
afiche-studio.feature1: Browser-based editor with live reload (SSE), autosave and shareable per-project URL
afiche-studio.feature2: Exports PNG / WEBP / JPG with deviceScaleFactor 1x–3x, sharp for retina and zoom
afiche-studio.feature3: Six formats derived from a single design: post, story, thumb, banner, og and wide
afiche-studio.feature5: Poster scaffolding that extracts design tokens (:root colors, fonts, radii) from an app with --app
afiche-studio.feature6: Fully self-hosted: no account, no cloud, no telemetry
afiche-studio.feature7: 27 tests with node:test and zero extra dependencies
